outputs.explanation: Panel A includes a bar graph (HMGB1 signal intensity, Nuc/Cyto, mean ± SD across genotypes) with N=4, n>100 cells, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
The lower graph in panel B is a bar chart of % aggregate-positive Purkinje cells (mean ± SD, N=4, n>400) with no individual data points shown.
Panel C is a western blot image only, with no accompanying quantification plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel D is a line plot (time on rotarod across weeks); line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel E consists of line plots (rotarod performance across days at different weeks); line plots are exempt.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve, a line plot, which is exempt from showing individual data points.
Panel G contains only micrograph images (immunostaining), no plot is present.
Panel H shows two bar charts (molecular layer thickness and Purkinje cell number, mean ± SD, N=3, n=9) without individual data points overlaid.
